framing.note: 封面开场必须看到完整的带拱花园门(拱+藤+门缝)。桌面视口矮宽,不能把 L3 门贴底填满宽度(会裁掉拱)——desktop L3 缩放到约 95% 视口高(≈880px)、水平居中、底部落地,让整座拱门+两侧花丛一眼看全。mobile 竖屏本就容得下整门,保持贴底填宽即可。
framing.textPlacement: 姓名 Hui Huang & Mayyi + 婚期放门缝中央偏下 / 门下方,压在暖光留白处;避开藤密与门板 Z 撑

desktop.prompt: Soft botanical watercolor illustration, loose wet-on-wet washes, delicate fine ink linework, dry-brush soft edges, cold-press watercolor paper grain, no digital noise, no glow, no glassmorphism; NOT a photograph, NOT 3D. Subject: a weathered pale wooden garden gate seen head-on, thrown WIDE OPEN in a grand welcoming way — both gate leaves swung INWARD, away from the viewer, pushed back into the garden until they lie almost flat against the inner sides of the frame posts. Because they swing inward the leaves are seen at a steep angle, foreshortened and receding into depth, so each leaf reads as a narrow slanted plane hugging its post. The clear opening between them is VERY wide — it takes up the great majority of the gateway, at least three quarters of the span between the posts. Climbing vines and small blossoms drape over the top beam and down the outer frame posts. The opened leaves are pale weathered wood at a soft mid value; keep dark ironwork and the densest vines on the top beam and outer frame, never across the central opening. Vines and blossoms rendered as solid clustered silhouette masses — no fine wispy tendrils or stray thin stems. Composition: the whole arched gate including its top beam fills the frame, anchored to the bottom edge, isolated element only; the central opening is a huge, clear, unobstructed void one could walk straight through. Background: solid pure white #FFFFFF, completely flat, no gradient, no vignette, no texture, no horizon line — and the central opening between the two open leaves must be that SAME solid pure white, completely empty (it is a see-through hole; put nothing inside it). Do not include: any garden, path, sky or scenery visible through the opening, cast shadows on the ground, reflections, side flower beds, distant wall, any other depth layer, haze, depth-of-field blur, motion blur, watermark, text. Edges: crisp, high-contrast silhouette, clean separation from background. Aspect ratio: 1:1
